clips.title: The story
paras: The Forgotten Coast forms the wild western shore of Feralas, where the ancient rainforest meets the Veiled Sea. Lumbering sea giants and water elementals roam this battered strand.

Stretching along the western edge of Feralas, the Forgotten Coast is a windswept shoreline confronting the expanse of the Veiled Sea. Unlike the dense canopy inland, this frontier is exposed to the elements and dominated by towering sea giants and roving water elementals pacing the surf. Travelers emerging from the forest canopy must contend with these primeval coastal guardians while navigating access to the sea, where ferry connections link to the night elven bastion of Sardor Isle.
